verdict.rationale: Supabase's own Realtime docs list "Postgres Changes: Listen to database changes in real-time," and the GitHub README lists "Realtime subscriptions" among its auto-generated APIs, so the product itself pushes database changes to subscribers without polling. Community comments add light corroboration that the realtime server exists and handles subscriptions. missing for 10: documented client-side subscription API and filtering/RLS behavior for change streams, hands-on independent confirmation of UI live-update behavior.

support.subject: As a developer, I can subscribe to live data changes so my UI updates in real time without polling
